prompts.name: war-master
prompts.prompt: Original production artwork for Monster Mash, detailed dark fantasy painted 2D game art, clean crisp silhouettes, solid material regions and preserved interior shading. No watermark, no lettering, no UI. Generate ONE square MASTER MAP seen directly overhead, orthographic top-down gameplay floor plan. Entire large continuous battlefield visible, no characters or creatures. Eight distinct broad open camps around a large open central ruined crossroads: NORTH necromancer graveyard, NORTHEAST violet arcane observatory ruins, EAST fang-carved predator den, SOUTHEAST giant's basalt quarry, SOUTH crimson marble royal court, SOUTHWEST dark blue spectral crypt, WEST silver moonlit woodland clearing, NORTHWEST wine-and-copper witch thorn garden. Each camp has a very broad unobstructed battle courtyard, connected by WIDE winding roads forming a complete ring and broad branching spokes across the center. Roads and camp floors should occupy most of the image; all narrow decorative obstacles confined to far camp borders. Room for dozens of moving troops abreast, no thin bridges, no steep isometric perspective, no huge foreground props across roads. Warm dusk battlefield transitioning between region palettes, continuous coherent stone-and-earth surface and natural transitions. Solid impassable boundary is a continuous low ruined fortification and dark thorn forest around the outermost margin only. Terrain and broad walking surfaces are immediately distinguishable. This is the exact master composition that will be sliced into 16 reference sectors and enlarged; prioritize coherent connections and large usable spaces.

sectorPrompt: Production top-down game terrain tile, precise detail enhancement of the supplied MASTER MAP CROP, sector {x},{y} of a continuous 4 by 4 battlefield. Redraw the EXACT same crop at high resolution. Preserve every road entry and exit at the image borders, widths, positions, floor shapes, walls, ruins, terrain colors, lighting and camera angle exactly. Do not recompose, zoom, add structures, remove paths or add borders. Crisp high quality painted dark fantasy stone, vegetation, camp architecture.
